title: Improved download performance
description: While profiling XML2R, I found a major bottleneck was downloading XML files. The speed was always significantly slower than my internet speed. By using a cluster to parallelize downloads, the speed increases from an at best 1 Mbps to a sustained 20 Mbps (or faster if you increase the number of nodes). I was able to use pitchRx to download and process a year's worth of data in under 15 minutes instead of hours. I also added progress bars to make things easier to read.
